heading.title: Of Grant of Probate and Letters of Administration

article.title: Form and effect of renunciation of executorship.
article.content:
230Form and effect of renunciation of executorship.

Section 230  ·  Part IX · Chapter I  ·  page 71 of the Act
The renunciation may be made orally in the presence of the Judge, or by a writing signed by the person renouncing, and when made shall preclude him from ever thereafter applying for probate of the will appointing him executor.
